sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Reject. The candidate still performs global ship-level checks rather than enforcing the requirement for every individual exposed machinery or foundation material: one approval evidence, authority, standard, approved status, and PST can incorrectly satisfy all materials. Bind each material to its own qualified approval-evidence/material-certificate record and require the authority, authorized standard alternative, approved status, and PST basis on that same qualification; do not merely require unrelated ship-level properties. The supplied hasEvidence relation is ship-owned and cannot provide the missing material-to-evidence binding, so locate the canonical per-material approval-evidence/material-certificate association term before regenerating.
